stem: In aerobic respiration, most ATP is produced by oxidative phosphorylation.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the features of ATP that make it suitable as the universal energy currency.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Rotenone is a compound that affects oxidative phosphorylation.

Rotenone disrupts the first carrier in the electron transport chain by stopping the transfer of electrons from this carrier.

Suggest and explain how rotenone reduces the production of ATP and water in aerobic respiration.
